notes: Six queued. 244 Jackson (foreclosed building marketed) is paywalled after the lede so nothing could be extracted; the lease renewals at 1550 Bryant and 185 Berry are tenant deals, not building facts; the rest name no building as their subject.

findings.description: Lender markets a foreclosed 28,000 sq ft Jackson Square building.

citation.label: The Registry, “Lender Markets Foreclosed 28,000 SQFT Jackson Square Building Assessed at $37.5MM in San Francisco,” 29 September 2026

raw.text: Lender Markets Foreclosed 28,000 SQFT Jackson Square Building Assessed at $37.5MM in San Francisco

publish.note: Paywalled after the lede: could not confirm from the text that the building is 244 Jackson (the sidebar lists 244 and 530 Jackson). Not extractable.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 244 JACKSON ST → parcel 0173007; sf-parcels has blklot 0173007 active, 220–244 JACKSON; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1913. EAS puts 220, 230, 244 JACKSON ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 220.
resolution.note: No page at this path yet; the parcel is the publisher's to seed.
